description: How to use the vike WebSocket stream (wss://stream.vike.io/v1/stream/<path>), read off the server's own registry: every path (hl, hl-cohorts, onchain, polymarket) with its channels; per channel its filter keys, each a list (with its maximum length), one value, a number (min_usd and the other min_ keys) or a boolean (contract: true or false, not a string), with the allowed values or the server's own message for a bad one, and its defaults (hl.fills: min_usd 1000 unless given); the REST catch-up route of each path; the limits (ONE connection per API key per path and THREE per account per path, newest wins with close 4410; 100 subscriptions per connection; a ping every 15 s); the close codes; cursor retention (3 days) and the subscribe message's shape. Check a filter with stream_check_filter and read missed events with stream_events.
name: stream_info
title: Stream Info
